plan: Psalm 12:1-8; Psalm 13:1-6; Psalm 14:1-7; Psalm 15:1-5; Psalm 16:1-11; Psalm 17:1-15; Psalm 19:1-14; Psalm 20:1-9; Psalm 21:1-13

readings.title: The Words of YeHoVaH are Clean
readings.subtitle: A Cry Amidst the Faithless
readings.text: [Psalm 12:1] Save, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for the lovingly-committed one is no more! For the trustworthy have ceased from among the sons of men. [2] They speak falsehood with each other; They speak with flattering lips, a double heart. [3] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> does cut off all flattering lips, A tongue that speaks swelling words, [4] Who have said, “With our tongue we do mightily; Our lips are our own; Who is master over us?” [5] <dq>“Because of the oppression of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy, <dn>I</dn> now arise,”</dq> says <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> set in safety – he pants for it.”</dq> [6] The Words of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> are clean Words, Silver tried in a furnace of earth, Refined seven times. [7] <dn>You</dn> guard them, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> preserve them from this generation forever. [8] The wrong walk around on every side, When worthlessness is exalted among the sons of men.

readings.title: How Long, O YeHoVaH?
readings.subtitle: Trusting in Divine Deliverance
readings.text: [Psalm 13:1] How long would <dn>You</dn> forget me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? Forever? How long would <dn>You</dn> hide <dn>Your</dn> face from me? [2] How long would I take counsel in my being, Grief in my heart day by day? How long would my enemy be exalted over me? [3] Look! Answer me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn>; Enlighten my eyes, Lest I sleep in death; [4] Lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him,” Lest my adversaries rejoice when I am moved. [5] But I have trusted in <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment; My heart rejoices in <dn>Your</dn> deliverance. [6] I sing to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Because <dn>He</dn> has been good to me.

readings.title: The Folly of the Godless
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH Looks Down from Heaven
readings.text: [Psalm 14:1] The fool has said in his heart, “There is no <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” They have done corruptly, They have done an abominable deed, There is no one who does good. [2] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> looked down from the heavens on the sons of mankind, To see if there is a wise one, seeking <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [3] They have all turned aside, They have together become filthy; No one is doing good, not even one. [4] Have all the workers of wickedness no knowledge, Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And do not call on <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? [5] There they are in great fear, For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is with the generation of the righteous. [6] <dn>You</dn> would put to shame the counsel of the poor, But <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is his refuge. [7] O that the deliverance of Yisra’ěl Would be given out of Tsiyon! When <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> turns back the captivity of <dn>His</dn> people, Let Ya‛aqoḇ rejoice, let Yisra’ěl be glad.

readings.title: Sojourning in the Set-Apart Tent
readings.subtitle: The Blameless Walk
readings.text: [Psalm 15:1] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who does sojourn in <dn>Your</dn> Tent? Who does dwell in <dn>Your</dn> set-apart mountain? [2] He who walks blamelessly, And does righteousness, And speaks the truth in his heart. [3] He has not slandered with his tongue, He has not done evil to his neighbour, Nor lifted up a reproach against his friend; [4] In whose eyes a reprobate one is despised, But he esteems <dn>את</dn> those who fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; He who swears to his own hurt and does not change; [5] He has not put out his silver at interest, And has not taken a bribe against the innocent. He who does these is never moved.

readings.title: The Portion of My Inheritance
readings.subtitle: Pleasures at the Right Hand
readings.text: [Psalm 16:1] Guard me, O <dn>Ěl</dn>, for I have taken refuge in <dn>You</dn>. [2] I have said to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “<dn>You</dn> are <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, I have no good beside <dn>You</dn>.” [3] As for the set-apart ones who are on the earth, They are the excellent ones, in whom is all my delight. [4] The sorrows of those who run after another one are increased; I would not pour out their drink offerings of blood, Nor take up <dn>את</dn> their names on my lips. [5] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is the portion of my inheritance and my cup; <dn>You</dn> uphold my lot. [6] Boundary lines have fallen to me in pleasant places; Indeed, a good inheritance is mine. [7] I bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> who has given me counsel; My kidneys also instruct me in the nights. [8] I have set <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> always before me; Because <dn>He</dn> is at my right hand I am not shaken. [9] Therefore my heart was glad, and my esteem rejoices; My flesh also dwells in safety. [10] For <dn>You</dn> do not leave my being in She’ol, Neither let <dn>Your</dn> Lovingly-committed One see corruption. [11] <dn>You</dn> show me the path of life; In <dn>Your</dn> presence is joy to satisfaction; At <dn>Your</dn> right hand are pleasures forever.

readings.title: Hear Righteousness, O YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: Guard Me as the Apple of Your Eye
readings.text: [Psalm 17:1] Hear righteousness, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Listen to my cry; Give ear to my prayer, From lips without deceit. [2] Let my right-ruling go out from <dn>Your</dn> presence; Let <dn>Your</dn> eyes see what is straight. [3] <dn>You</dn> have examined my heart; <dn>You</dn> have visited me in the night; <dn>You</dn> have tried me – <dn>You</dn> find I have not schemed; My mouth would not transgress. [4] As for the deeds of men – By the word of <dn>Your</dn> lips, I have kept myself from the paths of the destroyer. [5] My steps have held fast to <dn>Your</dn> paths, My feet have not slipped. [6] I have called upon <dn>You</dn>, for <dn>You</dn> answer me, O <dn>Ěl</dn>; Incline <dn>Your</dn> ear to me, hear my speech. [7] Let <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment be distinguished, <dn>You</dn> who save by <dn>Your</dn> right hand those who take refuge From those who rise up. [8] Guard me as the apple of <dn>Your</dn> eye. Hide me under the shadow of <dn>Your</dn> wings, [9] From the face of the wrong who ravage me, From my deadly enemies who surround me. [10] They are enclosed in their own fat, They speak proudly with their mouths, [11] They have now surrounded us in our steps, They set their eyes to cast us to the ground, [12] Like a lion who is eager to tear his prey, And as a young lion crouching in cover. [13] Arise, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Confront him, cause him to bend; Deliver my being from the wrong by <dn>Your</dn> sword, [14] From men by <dn>Your</dn> hand, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, From men of the world whose portion is in this life, And <dn>You</dn> fill their bellies with <dn>Your</dn> treasure, They are satisfied with children, And shall leave their riches to their babes. [15] As for me, let <dn>Me</dn> see <dn>Your</dn> face in righteousness; I am satisfied to see <dn>Your</dn> appearance when I awake.

readings.subsection: The Glory of the Creator and His Anointed
readings.title: The Heavens Proclaim
readings.subtitle: The Perfect Torah
readings.text: [Psalm 19:1] The heavens are proclaiming the esteem of <dn>Ěl</dn>; And the expanse is declaring the work of <dn>His</dn> hand. [2] Day to day pours forth speech, And night to night reveals knowledge. [3] There is no speech, and there are no words, Their voice is not heard. [4] Their line has gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them <dn>He</dn> set up a tent for the sun, [5] And it is like a bridegroom coming out of his room, It rejoices like a strong man to run the path. [6] Its rising is from one end of the heavens, And its circuit to the other end; And naught is hidden from its heat. [7] The Torah of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is perfect, bringing back the being; The witness of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is trustworthy, making wise the simple; [8] The orders of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> are straight, rejoicing the heart; The command of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is clear, enlightening the eyes; [9] The fear of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is clean, standing forever; The right-rulings of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> are true, They are righteous altogether, [10] More desirable than gold, Than much fine gold; And sweeter than honey and the honeycomb. [11] Also, <dn>Your</dn> servant is warned by them, In guarding them there is great reward. [12] Who discerns mistakes? Declare me innocent from those that are secret, [13] Also keep <dn>Your</dn> servant back from presumptuous ones, Do not let them rule over me. Then shall I be perfect, and innocent of great transgression. [14] Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be pleasing before <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, my rock and my redeemer.

readings.subsection: The Glory of the Creator and His Anointed
readings.title: A Banner in the Name of Elohim
readings.subtitle: Trusting in the Sovereign
readings.text: [Psalm 20:1] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> does answer you in the day of distress! The Name of the <dn>Elohim</dn> of Ya‛aqoḇ does set you on high! [2] <dn>He</dn> does send you help from the set-apart place, And does uphold you from Tsiyon! [3] <dn>He</dn> does remember all your offerings, And does accept your ascending offering! Selah. [4] <dn>He</dn> does give you according to your heart, And fills all your plans! [5] We sing of <dn>Your</dn> deliverance, And in the Name of our <dn>Elohim</dn> we set up a banner! <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> does fill all your requests! [6] Now I know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall save <dn>His</dn> Anointed; <dn>He</dn> answers him from <dn>His</dn> set-apart heavens With the saving might of <dn>His</dn> right hand. [7] Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, But we remember the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn>. [8] They, they have bowed down and fallen; But we have risen and are established. [9] Save, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! Let the Sovereign answer us in the day we call.

readings.subsection: The Glory of the Creator and His Anointed
readings.title: The Sovereign Rejoices
readings.subtitle: The Crown of Fine Gold
readings.text: [Psalm 21:1] The sovereign rejoices in <dn>Your</dn> strength, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; And how greatly he exults in <dn>Your</dn> deliverance! [2] <dn>You</dn> have given him the desire of his heart, And <dn>You</dn> have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah. [3] For <dn>You</dn> put before him the blessings of goodness; <dn>You</dn> set a crown of fine gold on his head. [4] He asked life from <dn>You</dn>, and <dn>You</dn> gave it to him – Length of days forever and ever. [5] Through <dn>Your</dn> deliverance his esteem is great; <dn>You</dn> have laid excellency and splendour on him. [6] For <dn>You</dn> have made him most blessed forever; <dn>You</dn> have made him glad with the joy of <dn>Your</dn> presence. [7] For the sovereign is trusting in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And through the loving-commitment of the Most High he is not moved. [8] <dn>Your</dn> hand reaches all <dn>Your</dn> enemies; <dn>Your</dn> right hand reaches those who hate <dn>You</dn>. [9] <dn>You</dn> make them as a furnace of fire in the time of <dn>Your</dn> presence; <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> does swallow them up in <dn>His</dn> wrath, And fire does consume them. [10] <dn>You</dn> destroy their fruit from the earth, And their seed from among the sons of men. [11] For they held out evil against <dn>You</dn>; They devised a plot; they do not prevail. [12] For <dn>You</dn> make them turn their back, When <dn>You</dn> aim with <dn>Your</dn> bowstring toward their faces. [13] Be exalted, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, in <dn>Your</dn> strength! We sing and we praise <dn>Your</dn> might.
